avis.titre: Like a Sonicare for Your Skin!
avis.texte: The Overview: The Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel has become my holy grail for skin exfoliation. It's not your typical scrub; this gel is uniquely formulated to provide an exceptional exfoliating experience for both face and body. The Good: Unique Exfoliation: Unlike scrubs with harsh granules, this peeling gel uses small, textured elements that gently lift off dead skin cells without any abrasiveness. The sensation is akin to watching dead skin peel away, leaving your skin feeling rejuvenated. Efficacy: After using this product, my skin feels as smooth and clean as post-Sonicare brushing, but for the face and body. It's gentle yet effective, making it perfect for sensitive skin types or those who prefer a less aggressive approach to exfoliation. Gentle Formula: The inclusion of natural ingredients like Apricot Blossom extract adds a nourishing aspect to the exfoliation process, enhancing hydration and leaving skin not just exfoliated but also soothed. Versatility: Suitable for both face and body, this product maximizes utility, making it a staple in my skincare routine. The Not-So-Good: Really, It's Hard to Find Flaws: If I had to nitpick, I might mention that the texture might not appeal to everyone since it's different from traditional scrubs, but that's more about preference than a flaw. Overall: This exfoliating gel from Beauty of Joseon has transformed my skincare routine. It's now my go-to product for that clean, smooth skin feeling without the irritation

To preface this review, my skin is very acne-prone and tends to hate most acids, even gentle ones like gluconolactone and lactic acid. But my skin LOVES fruit extracts and enzymes so when I saw the ingredients list for this peeling gel, I thought, I have to try this! I already use (and love) the green plum cleanser from BOJ so when I saw the apricot blossom peeling gel, I got a little giddy. It's a pretty pink bottle that will look good next to the green one for the cleanser. Anyway, besides aesthetics, this was such a nice and pleasant product! I used it and was so impressed with how gentle it was, but it still managed to exfoliate my skin because my face felt noticeably soft afterwards. Best of all, there was no stinging and no perfume-y smell. I used a peeling gel recently from another brand and omg, the perfume smell was way too strong. Can confirm that the BOJ peeling gel is unscented. All in all, very user friendly and a great purchase!

I have ordered this product 20 times! I’m 59 and a tretinoin user. My skin is accustom to using the combination of tretinoin and this peeling gel. You must work up to the tolerance of using these but it’s so worth it. I use this peeling gel everyday. It gently sloughs off the dead skin and leaves my skin so soft. It absolutely does exfoliate the dead skin cells that you have to get rid of for healthy glowing skin. I highly recommend. I love this product.

This is by far my favorite skin care item I’ve ever had! Does exactly what it says it will, and isn’t too harsh on sensitive skin either. Almost every facial wash/cleanser/exfoliant I’ve ever tried has made me break out worse except this one. Will definitely be buying again!

Hello everyone! I typically never write reviews but this deserves it. I’ve been struggling with acne for 16 years now. Nothing worked. My skin always looked dull, felt rough and was always breaking out. I’ve tried every different type of skin care adjusting my routine according to my skin and honestly, this exfoliant is staying in my routine FOREVER. No matter what other products I use with this exfoliant, my skin always comes out soft/smooth and my acne cleared up!!! I’ve never seen my skin so glowy, soft and acne free. Thank you Beauty of Joseon!

I have very dry skin and it peels a lot so I wanted an exfoliating cleanser that was gentle and wouldn’t irritate my skin. Really good and didn’t irritate my skin. No bad scent and easy to use! I will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Gentle but gets the job done!
avis.texte: I have super picky skin (usually either doesn’t react to products or reacts badly), but this exfoliator has significantly improved my skin! I use about twice a week after washing and love it!
Nice but made me break out. Not good if you have sensitive skin.
Es el mejor protector solar que he usado en la vida. No deja nada de sensación grasa, hidrata la piel y la deja suavísiam. Lo compraría mil veces.

La texture est vraiment comme j'aime , le résultat est pour moi concluant ! Je suis adepte de cette marque .. mais franchement là douceur me surprend encore. J'ai du mal a l'utiliser tellement je l'aime 🙀

Lo trovo un prodotto molto valido, soprattutto per pelli sensibili, perché esfolia bene senza aggredire le parti più delicate e reattive del viso. Di solito sconsigliano gli esfolianti che si trasformano in granuli, ma questo forma delle sfere soffici, facili anche da lavare via, e ne basta poco per pulire tutto il viso, quindi dura tanto!
Now that its been sold by BoJ official, I don’t mind buying from amazon as several other products here are dupe. I love the price when on deal, its a great product from a great brand!

avis.titre: Limpia tu rostro sin dañar la piel
avis.texte: Me a encantado mi cara a quedado limpia con una sensación agradable no es áspera puedes usarla diariamente después de retirar maquillaje .

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL FOR DRY SKIN GIRLIES
avis.texte: Hands-down, the best exfoliating wash I've ever used. I buy them 3 at a time now. Can't live without it. I have INCREDIBLY dry skin, especially a large patch on my forehead. This is the only exfoliation that gives me immediate results, and leaves my skin soft and smooth.
I bought this to replace my exfoliator during pregnancy. This is ok to use 2-3 times a week as it’s really gentle. But sometime, it’s too weak to clean pore

I really love this peeling. It’s gentle to my skin. I love the packaging and it’s not my first product by Beauty of Joseon, so I trust this brand. My sling is smooth and clean. Good price for this amount of product. I recommend it.

This stuff is amazing! I’ve had dark rings around my neck for forever that I’m super self conscious about. I’ve tried scrubbing, all sorts of brushes, hydrogen peroxide, etc. and nothing has worked. I just rubbed this in and it took it completely off! I put a glob of fresh scrub for comparison. So satisfying.

Been struggling with how to remove dark dead skin off my son especially without him squealing like he can’t breathe lol this product worked amazing ! See picture for results . In just 3 days his skin looks soooo much cleaner. Just gentle massaging on dry areas before showering and viola✨

This cloudy gel like paste is easy or your skin with tremendous results. Wash your face (preferably with cleansing balm and then cleanser) then in damp skin apply the gel and begin to massage in circular motions until your face is full of this like crumbles and rinse off. You’ll notice the shine your face takes on as if you literally polished your face. Then just do your hydrating skin care as normal (minus the exfoliation pads). Has a very faint smell that you really won’t even notice unless you try.

I’m a Master Esthetician and skincare junkie, no rookie to aggressive product or treatments. I know what I’m doing, and I’ve NEVER had this happen after using a product once. I used this enzyme last night for the first time and followed it with my usual routine, no other new products. I woke up with this rash on both cheeks and forehead. I know this product is the culprit because I only used it on my face, whereas all my other products I carry down my neck and chest. My neck and chest are clear. I reviewed the ingredients before purchasing, I know I’m not allergic to any of them. A gommage(enzyme exfoliant) is typically less aggressive than a physical face scrub, so maybe I got a bad batch? No other harsh products were used in the same routine. My professional opinion? Don’t buy this, if it’s irritating the skin of someone who works in the industry then theres something amiss. I hope I can return but obviously I did open and use it.

I really enjoy how my skin feels after using the cleanser. It's such a lovely physical exfoliation without any of the irritation. HOW TO USE: This can be a bit confusing to use. You must apply it to dry skin. If the product is applied to wet or damp skin, it won't function as desired and the pilling effect won't work well.

This is the most unique exfoliating cleanser I’ve ever used. It has very fine exfoliating granules. As you rub it over moistened skin, it begins to form white chunky clumps. It did the same on my face as it does on my hand in the video. Then it occurred to me, it’s called peeling gel. I’m not sure if the white chunks are my dead skin cells peeling off, or if the product just forms chunks when applying. Either way, it left my skin feeling exceptionally smooth and soft. It is recommended to use this 1 to 2 times per week, so I’m assuming that was dead skin. I didn’t really detect any scent. I really like this product, and love how I feel like it’s polishing my face. Price point is on target.
This peel seemed to work well and was easy to use. Very light scent so it’s not overwhelming. My face felt very clean after using.

I thought “peeling mask” meant that it would dry and you would peel it off; but this is actually more of a scrub-and-wash situation. Kinda gross: I have INSANELY dry, sensitive skin, and you can always see the cracks through makeup. Tried this out and immediately little white balls of dead skin started to build up. I don’t think this product has any moisturizing aspects, but my skin is much softer and has a nice glow. I did have a very slight allergic reaction to this because of sensitivity, but no burning or uncomfortable feeling (just redness). 10/10!

This peeling was wonderful! I've been looking for this peeling! It not hard on the skin, make my skin smoother and remove my dead skin! Been more than 4 months using it and it really work for me. Just dont over use it bcs it can make your skin irritated. Just use once or twice in a week.
This is my skin after using it for 1 week. It didn’t deliver the results I expected, and my skin felt dry and irritated after use. For the price, I expected much better quality. DO NOT BUY!! 👎

avis.titre: Had an allergic reaction, be careful
avis.texte: Idk what ingredient in this product I could possibly be allergic to, but all BoJ products work wonders except this one. The pictures show the rash that covered my face 2 days after the initial reaction, after taking extra strength allergy medication every 4 hours and wearing hydrocortisone ointment 24/7. It was twice as bad at first but I couldn’t look at myself without crying so I didn’t get pictures. I’d say, even if all the other products work, do a spot test on your hand or wrist first, for this one. I’m scared to use any new products from them now…

avis.titre: I really didn't like it because it's not the original.
avis.texte: This product is incredible, I personally liked it a lot, it leaves my skin radiant.
It left my skin dry I have combination skin and acne prone It cause more breakouts

avis.titre: Not a normal gel peel like you might think
avis.texte: This product is overall pretty good. It did not irritate my skin or cause any adverse reaction. It was a pretty gentle exfoliating. I didn’t notice any strange odor and it went on smoothly. It’s more of a cream than a gel and it takes a very small amount to do its job. Almost immediately after rubbing the cream on my skin, the texture balled up strangely and became more difficult to spread it around. It felt kinda sticky and weird. I’m guess that is the gentle exfoliating part where it’s picking up dead skin and grime from my skin. After a quick rinse, I felt my skin somewhat refreshed and rejuvenated. I’m going to need to try this several more times before I can give a definitive judgement on how well it works. For now, it seems to be working and I’m glad to see that it has a reasonable price point.

This Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel from Beauty of Joseon is made in Korea and comes in a 100 ml (3.38 fl. oz.) tube. This is a very gentle exfoliant. I have used scrubs and peels in the past. This is my first time using a gommage type of exfoliant and I really like it. My face feels very smooth and soft after use. It is easy to use. Take a penny sized amount and apply to clean skin in a circular motion for 20 seconds. Your dead skin cells bind the with gel and wash away when you rinse with warm water. Instructions on tube advises to use once or twice a week. I do not smell any scent. This product should last awhile, at least a few months, since you only use a penny sized amount each time. I have dry skin and I did feel the need to moisturize after use. I am happy with the results I got from this product.

This gel has the texture of a thin cream and feels quite nice as you massage it over your skin. The scent is so light as to be unnoticeable. As you work it into your skin, it rolls up into little balls, like when you rub a dirty spot on your skin and the dirt balls up (not a pretty mental image, I know, but I have to believe we've all done that). It gently but quickly exfoliates your face. Immediately after the first time I used it, I felt my face was softer. I usually need to give new products some time and trial before making that kind of statement, but there was honestly an immediate result. There are a multitude of facial cleansers available on Amazon, but this it the first of it's kind that I've tried. At $13, I think it is well priced and can see myself purchasing this when I run out.
